subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should OpenClaw adopt, rebase, or replace the open closing PR to remove ambient cwd from mirrored transcript header creation?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and narrow, but the affected metadata crosses session/security boundaries and an open closing PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
options.body: Rebase or replace the open closing PR so mirrored header creation receives an explicit target workspace and this issue closes after merge.

options.title: Close the stale PR and queue a replacement
options.body: If the current PR is too outdated to salvage, close it only after a narrow replacement path is ready.

options.title: Defer to broader cwd isolation
options.body: Keep this issue open for broader runtime cwd cleanup, accepting that ordinary mirrored headers can still use ambient cwd until then.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the open closing PR so mirrored header creation receives an explicit target workspace and this issue closes after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete landed the delivery mirroring path where this bug became reachable and later maintained mirror dedupe in the same area.
